title: Mediterranean Chickpea Dumplings
description: A delicious and healthy vegetarian dish made with chickpea dumplings, Mediterranean flavors, and a crispy exterior.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the chickpea flour and Mediterranean seasoning blend.
Gradually add in the water, stirring with a fork until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Use a rolling pin to flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and add the olive oil.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer the dumplings to a plate and sprinkle with chopped parsley, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
